verdict.rationale:
Codex is fundamentally an AI coding agent designed for task delegation — docs explicitly describe 'delegate a longer task and return when it's ready,' subagent delegation ('Ask Codex to delegate focused work to specialized agents'), cloud/async task execution, and CLI/IDE/desktop delegation modes. Community reports corroborate real-world task delegation working (e.g., completing coding tasks, generating diffs/PRs) alongside some mixed quality/speed complaints, but the core delegate-to-assistant capability is clearly evidenced and functioning.

missing for 10: independent rigorous benchmarking of delegation reliability across many tasks, and less mixed community sentiment on quality/consistency.
